name: Frostfire
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 15 ft.
Area cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A cone of freezing ice shoots from your fingertips.

Any creature in the area of the blast takes 1d4 points of cold damage per caster level (maximum 5d4).
